show.description: Dr. Dev Trivedi, a divine healer who brings even the dead back to life, becomes a legend after reviving billionaire Mr. Singhaniya. But his world crumbles when his wife, Nita, betrays him—stealing his sacred secrets to build her empire and plotting his death. At her dazzling IPO launch, shocking truths surface: the real savior and mother of his child is their servant, Kavita. Awakened as Param Ved Ji, Dev unleashes divine justice—proving that no power can outshine the truth.
